text:
mira: Heads-up — I pushed a stricter package.json exports map for @redwood-inference/sdk to force ESM entrypoints and several internal Next/Vercel sample apps started 500ing on edge builds.

sam: ouch. any error logs or a repro?

mira: minimal repro in monorepo sandbox. Edge import fails with: `Error: Cannot find module '/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk'`. Node server containers (node:16) are fine.

lee: that usually means the conditional exports don't match what Vercel/bundlers expect. What does the exports map look like now?

mira: right now it's just: "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }, "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts" }

sam: two problems: many edge resolvers dislike a bare `.` mapping without file fallbacks, and `./types` as a subpath doesn't work for some TS versions — we should add top-level `types`.

lee: pragmatic fix: re-add `main`, `module`, and `types` fields, expand `exports` with `browser` and `default` fallbacks, add a `./*` wildcard, and ship an `edge.mjs` that re-exports the ESM bundle for platforms that only resolve the package root. Example patch: "main": "./dist/index.cjs", "module": "./dist/index.mjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "exports": { ".": { "browser": "./edge.mjs", "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs", "default": "./dist/index.cjs" }, "./*": "./dist/*.js" }.

mira: also found a dynamic `require()` in our auth/retry test helper that breaks in ESM-only consumers. We'll convert helpers to named ESM exports and publish a tiny CJS shim for compatibility.

sam: add an edge-like smoke test (vercel dev or bun) to sample-apps CI so we catch regressions. Also update the SDK changelog with a pin suggestion for internal teams.

build-bot: queued patch branch mira/sdk-exports-compat -> staging

lee: agree — prefer shipping a patch with compatibility shims and docs rather than a breaking major. mira: please open a PR with repro + CI fix and a short README note explaining why `edge.mjs` exists and how different runtimes resolve packages.

mira: PR opened with repro and proposed patch. Will follow up with changelog blurb and smoke CI before cutting the release.
